name: Professor's Darling
source:
Your ex leaves you broken-hearted and second-guessing yourself after a nasty breakup, and you decide to put romance on the back burner to focus on your studies. One fateful day you walk into class only to find you have a new university professor, and he's smokin' hot!

[From in-app]
translation:
在一次糟糕的分手后，你的前任让你心碎并开始反思自己，你决定暂时搁置浪漫，专注于你的学习。有一天，你走进教室，却发现一位新的大学教授，而且他非常性感！

[来自应用程序内]
